elaine (sec-eng): Heads-up: lifecycle compose on a backup bucket stripped our CMEK metadata. Re-encrypt job skipped objects because it trusts x-goog-meta-encryption flag. Need quick triage.

mike (infra): timeline + scope?

elaine (sec-eng): Detected in prod at 02:30 UTC. Two tenant prefixes affected, ~7 objects so far. Lifecycle moved objects to NEARLINE and composed parts.

rachel (encops): GCS compose can drop user metadata. We must not rely on uploader-set headers.

sam (sre): devops: show re-encrypt log around 03:00

oncall-bot: re-encrypt-backups-03:00 logs: INFO found object storageClass=NEARLINE metadata.encryption=sse skip reason=metadata.indicates_encrypted

lucas (platform): Short-term: disabling lifecycle on affected buckets. Longer-term: change re-encrypt job to validate via a cheap KMS envelope-check instead of header only. PR ready for canary.

mike (infra): I'll disable lifecycle and prepare KMS grants for the rewrite worker. Throttle KMS QPS to 50 for rewrap.

rachel (encops): Repair plan: server-side object-rewrite with kmsKeyName set (no plaintext egress), verify checksums, atomically promote new generation. Also notify compliance.

elaine (sec-eng): Action items: disable lifecycle (lucas), run scanner and build /tmp/needs-rewrap (sam), deploy rewrap canary (lucas), KMS grants + throttles (mike), compliance notice (rachel). Tagging @oncall-bot.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-93 created (P2) - assigned to encops+infra.

sam (sre): Scanner running now prioritizing NEARLINE objects missing x-goog-meta-kms-key. Will update with results.
